# M5 drift study, RQ3 (generated by scripts/m5_summary.py)

Score: MWPM gap. Calibrators fitted on the source Train split, threshold certified by Learn-then-Test on the source Calibrate split (delta = 0.05), measured on the target Test split. Round counts 1, 10, 30, 50. Per-pair rows: `results/m5_drift.csv`, `results/m5_calibration.csv`.

## Does the certificate transfer? Prior: RL-optimized

Each cell: significant exceedance / exceedance, over certified source-target pairs (certified pairs in brackets). Exceedance = target Test error among kept shots above alpha; significant = its one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound is above alpha. In-distribution, the guarantee allows at most delta = 5% of true exceedances. "kept none": the source threshold keeps no target Test shot (counted as no exceedance).
